description_en: Stops a flow log instance. After the flow log is stopped, traffic of the specified resource is no longer captured
description_zh: 调用DeactiveFlowLog接口停止流日志，停止后不再捕获指定资源的流量
kebab_example: aliyun vpc deactive-flow-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-id fl-m5e8vhz2t21sel1nq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeactiveFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the flow log. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 流日志所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
